name: omneity-app-build-evals
purpose: Evaluate whether the single Omneity skill routes to enough guidance to build real apps, not only call endpoints.

queries.query: Implement a streaming multilingual chat route and client UI. Keep the API key server-side and show retryable errors.
success_criteria: Uses backend proxy instead of exposing secrets
Handles streaming and final message reconciliation
Defines user-facing loading and failure states
Validates message roles and non-empty input

queries.query: Build a hosted-vector RAG pipeline for uploaded markdown files using embeddings and chat.
success_criteria: Passes compact retrieved context into chat

queries.query: Build a private docs search chatbot where indexing runs on our own server.
success_criteria: Places Semango behind an auth boundary
Uses Omneity chat only after retrieval

queries.query: Route short user messages by language, detect Arabizi, and choose UI copy accordingly.
success_criteria: Uses language ID only where explicit routing is needed
Does not infer identity or sensitive attributes
Stores language metadata only when useful

queries.query: Build contact search that matches names across Arabic and Latin spellings.
success_criteria: Uses language encoding for retrieval keys
Tests realistic misspellings and script variants

queries.query: Make a songwriting assistant that suggests replacement words while preserving rhyme.
Upload video audio, transcribe it, align subtitles, and let users download SRT.
success_criteria: Validates file type, duration, and size
Uses transcription before alignment when no transcript exists

queries.query: Build a backend that lets allowed users run approved existing trails and see status.
success_criteria: Uses Herd CLI with explicit JSON params
Stores trail version, action, status, and runtime
Shows queued, running, complete, and failed states

queries.query: Create and iterate a new trail for a site workflow that no registry trail covers.
success_criteria: Defines job, inputs, outputs, and success criteria
Captures logs or screenshots for debugging
Packages or pins a tested version

queries.query: Connect browser devices and stream events into an internal automation dashboard.
success_criteria: Keeps device identifiers server-side when possible

queries.query: Deploy Semango for a project folder and exclude generated files before indexing.
success_criteria: Monitors health, stats, and query latency

queries.query: Automate website research, index collected files locally, and summarize results with citations.
